findings.title: Feature-disabled check path and changed exit codes are not verified
findings.body: The new testFeatureNotEnabled test launches only the update-compatibility metadata subcommand and asserts only its error message. The check subcommand has a separate feature gate in UpdateCompatibilityCheck.run(), so removing or breaking that gate would not fail any test despite the documentation promising that both commands fail when rolling-updates is disabled. The test also does not assert the new FEATURE_DISABLED exit code 4, and testWrongVersions does not assert the recreate exit code after CompatibilityResult changed it from 4 to 3 and reassigned 4 to feature-disabled. Because the guide explicitly tells automation to rely on the exit code rather than messages, these contract changes could regress without detection.
